reviews.title: Travelling in sudan airways is so irritating
reviews.text: As been the cheapest airline to travel from Nigeria to sudan, there have been a lot of mess regarding their takeoff time, they usually postponed ones booking till next time atleast a week, which means after u get to the airport on the day of your flight, u would found that there plane isn't arrive yet, and you will receive an information from any of their agent saying flight for today has been cancelled, so you have to wait till next week. which means go back home till next fix time, a lot of people has experienced such kind of mess. didn't you?
reviews.author: avidreader2016

reviews.title: PRAY BEFORE TAKING OFF AND SAY THANKS UPON LANDING
reviews.text: I took this flight - usually old airbuses - on numerous occasions and never really had any problems or bad experiences of any sort bar losing one bag to what seemed like acid rain. Crew were always helpful but the baggage service was something else! However, there were numerous fatal crashes during my few years in the Sudan and maybe my praying somehow helped?
reviews.author: kelvinwilliama2014
